## What we will cover

1.  [{gtsummary} fundamentals]{.emphasis} — `tbl_summary()`, hierarchical tables, merging and stacking.

2.  [Analysis Results Data]{.emphasis} — every number in a table is saved, machine-readable, and extractable.

3.  [Print engines]{.emphasis} — {gt}, {flextable}, and Word output.

4.  [Themes]{.emphasis} — set your defaults once, for every table.

5.  [Coding agents]{.emphasis} — writing your standards down so an agent follows them.

## About you

We are assuming you:

-   Are [comfortable in R]{.emphasis} and have seen the [tidyverse]{.emphasis} — the native pipe, {dplyr}.

-   [No prior {gtsummary} experience]{.emphasis} is needed.

This is an [introduction]{.emphasis} to {gtsummary}: what it does, how to customize it, and where to go next.
